newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products sink, gas oil demand seen poor.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products sink, gas oil demand seen poor.

text.p: NWE oil products fell on Tuesday with limited demand, the gas oil market noticeably short of buyers, dealers said.

Heating oil prices dropped $2 a tonne. The weaker underlying IPE levels, the cause of the fall, stalled further losses of premiums at the opening. However premiums may soften as majors still wanted to shift prompt product with almost no-one willing to buy, traders said.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were assessed at around $110 fob ARA, some $2 below Monday's close.
